blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Probes are the workhorse of interpretability. If a model’s hidden states predict a variable, the model is said to represent it. But a probe score has no fixed meaning. An R 2 R^{2} of 0.6 may only reflect what the input already gives away, and the same score can mean different things on different data. We propose reading every probe score against two reference points: a floor, what a declared set of simple inputs already predicts, and a ceiling, what the full input can predict. The gap between them, the headroom, is the range in which a probe can show that a model computes something beyond the simple inputs. We prove that headroom vanishes in two ways: the target stops depending on a hidden variable the model must infer, or the input stops revealing it. We test this on transformers trained for in-context meta-analysis, which must infer the hidden heterogeneity between studies to weight them correctly, and where both reference points are known. Under distribution shift, probe scores fall and prediction error rises 12 12 – 15 × 15\times , yet the model recovers a similar share of the headroom, indicating that the data lost information, not the representation. We then analyze the real models.The single-cell foundation model scGPT encodes biological variability only partially. We also revisit four influential LLM probing studies, which claim that models represent geography, the state of an Othello board, truth, and the demographics of their users. Against a floor computed from the input text alone, some of these claims hold, while others are largely explained by the text itself.
blocks.zh: 探测器是可解释性的工作马. 如果一个模型的隐藏状态是预测一个变量,据说这个模型代表它. 但探测分数没有固定的意义. 0.6分的R 2 R^{2}可能只反映输入已经给出的内容,同分数在不同的数据上可以指不同的东西. 我们提议根据两个参考点来读取每个探测器的分数:一个底数,一个已经宣布的一组简单输入,一个天花板,一个完整的输入可以预测的. 它们之间的间隙,头室,是探测器可以显示模型计算出超出简单输入范围的东西的范围. 我们证明了头室消失的方式有两种:目标停止取决于模型必须推断的隐藏变量,或者输入停止透露. 我们用训练有素的变压器来测试它, 它必须推断研究之间隐藏的异质性, 以正确衡量它们, 以及两个参考点的位置。 在分布转移下,探针分数倒计时,预测出错上升了12 12 — 15 × 15\times,然而模型却回收了同样一股主室分数,表明数据丢失了信息,而不是表现. 然后我们分析真正的模型。 单细胞基模型 scGPT 编码生物学可变性只部分. 我们还重温了4个有影响力的LLM检测研究,这些研究声称模型代表了地理学,奥赛罗板的状况,真理,以及使用者的人口统计. 根据仅从输入文本中得出的一个下限,有些索赔成立,而另一些则主要由文本本身加以解释。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Understanding what information is represented inside a complex system is a central problem across biological and artificial intelligence. In neuroscience, decoding analyses use neural population activity to ask whether variables such as sensory features, cognitive states, or behavioral quantities are represented in the brain; analogous methods are now widely used to study the hidden representations of learned artificial networks ( Quian Quiroga and Panzeri, 2009 ; Naselaris et al., 2011 ; Belinkov, 2022 ) . In modern AI, where high-dimensional internal states are otherwise difficult to interpret directly, probes provide a particularly simple and scalable readout: a classifier or regressor is trained to predict a quantity of interest from a model’s hidden states, and its predictive performance is used to assess how strongly that quantity is represented ( Alain and Bengio, 2016 ; Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) . Such measurements underlie claims about what models encode, how representations emerge during learning and how information is distributed across layers ( Tenney et al., 2019 ; Saphra and Lopez, 2019 ) . They therefore carry substantial scientific weight, as conclusions about the internal organization of both biological and artificial systems can depend on what a probe score is taken to mean.
blocks.zh: 了解复杂系统内的信息是什么是跨越生物和人工智能的核心问题。 在神经科学中,解码分析使用神经人口活动来询问大脑中是否代表了感官特征,认知状态等变量,或者行为量等变量;现在,类似方法被广泛用于研究所学人工网络的隐含表现(Quian Quiroga and Panzeri,2009;Naselaris等,2011;Belinkov,2022). 在现代AI中,高维度内部状态在其他方面难以直接解释,探针提供了一种特别简单和可扩展的读取:一个分类器或后退器经过培训,可以预测一个模型隐藏状态的一定数量的兴趣,其预测性能被用来评估该数量代表的程度(Alain and Bengio, 2016;Hewitt and Liang, 2019). 此类测量基于关于何种模型编码、在学习过程中如何出现表述以及信息如何分层分布的说法(Tenney等,2019年;Saphra和Lopez,2019年)。 因此它们具有相当大的科学分量,因为关于生物和人工系统内部组织的结论可能取决于探测分数的含意。

blocks.en: Yet this widespread use exposes a basic interpretive problem: a raw probe score has no intrinsic scale of evidential strength. A high R 2 R^{2} may arise because the target is predictable from readily available input information rather than because the representation captures the computation of interest, and the same numerical score can carry different implications across distributions as this baseline predictability changes ( Ravichander et al., 2021 ; Elazar et al., 2021 ; Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) . Interpreting probe scores therefore requires knowing not only what is decodable but also how much decodability is achievable without the computation of interest and how much is achievable from all available information. We study this distinction in a controlled evidence-aggregation task. We train transformer models in a random-effects meta-analysis setting where the sufficient statistics and the oracle Bayes estimator conditional on the true heterogeneity parameter are known in closed form. Under a distribution shift, the raw decodability of the sufficient statistic falls and the prediction error rises, and the raw scores alone cannot say whether the representation degraded or the data became less informative.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种广泛的使用暴露了一个基本的解释性问题:原始探测分数没有内在的证据强度尺度。 高R 2 R^{2}可能会出现,因为从现成的输入信息来看,目标是可以预测的,而不是因为表示能捕捉到利息的计算,而同样的数值得分会随着这一基线可预测性的变化而在分布上产生不同的影响(Ravichander等,2021;Elazar等,2021;Hewitt和Liang,2019). 因此,解释探针分数不仅需要知道什么是可解码的,而且需要知道如果不计算利息可以实现多少可解码,以及从所有可获得的信息可以实现多少可解码。 我们研究了这种区分 在一个有控制的证据汇总任务。 我们用随机效应元分析设置来训练变压器模型,其中以真实异质性参数为条件的足够统计数据和甲骨文活塞估计器以封闭形式被知道. 在分布变化下,足够统计数据的原始可解码性下降,预测出错上升,仅凭原始分数不能说其表现是否退化,或数据资料是否较少。

blocks.en: To separate computation from statistical artifact, we introduce a framework that normalizes probe scores against the bounds implied by the information sets that the scientific question specifies. We partition the available information into restricted information ( O O ) and additional evidence ( X X ) used to infer a latent variable ( Z Z ). We evaluate probe decodability between two population reference points (under the true data distribution): a floor ( ρ O 2 \rho_{O}^{2} ), which measures the predictability achievable from the baseline alone, and a ceiling ( ρ I 2 \rho_{I}^{2} ), which measures the maximum predictability achievable given full information ( I I ), which represents all available evidence. We define the gap between these reference points as headroom ( Δ \Delta ): the maximum variance a probe could explain by successfully inferring the latent variable Z Z from X X (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 为了将计算与统计文物区分开来,我们采用了一个框架,使探测分数与科学问题所指明的成套信息所隐含的界限相一致。 我们将现有信息分为限制信息(O O)和用来推断潜在变量(Z Z )的额外证据(X X )。 我们评价两个人口参考点(在真实数据分布之下)之间的可解码性:一个底线(ρO 2\rho_{O}^{O}2}),用来衡量仅从基线即可达到的可预测性,另一个是上限(ρI 2\rho_{I}^{2}),用来衡量在充分信息(一一)下所能达到的最大限度的可预测性,它代表了所有可用的证据。 我们把这些参考点之间的空隙定义为前厅(QQ\Delta):一个探测器通过从XX(图1)中成功推断出潜在的可变ZZ来解释最大差异.

blocks.en: The theoretical result demonstrates that this headroom can vanish through two mechanisms: weak target sensitivity (where the target ceases to depend on the latent variable) and weak identification (where the evidence becomes too noisy to identify the latent variable). When headroom vanishes, raw probe scores can cease to provide evidence about the computation of interest. We test the estimation procedure in the meta-analysis task and a synthetic single-cell model, where the generative model is known and the reference points can be computed exactly by numerical integration. We then apply it to real single-cell data and to published LLM probes, where the reference points can only be estimated from samples. Analyses of a fine-tuned chemistry model and recorded neural activity appear in Appendix J .
blocks.zh: 理论结果表明,这个头室可以通过两种机制消失:弱目标敏感性(即目标不再依赖于潜在变量)和弱识别(即证据变得太吵而无法确定潜在变量). 当头室消失时,原始探测分数可以停止提供计算利息的证据. 我们在元分析任务和合成单细胞模型中测试估计程序,在这个模型中,基因模型是已知的,参照点可以精确地通过数字整合来计算. 然后把它应用于真实的单细胞数据和已公布的LLM探测器,在这些探测器中只能从样品中估算出参考点. 对微调化学模型和记录神经活性的分析载于附录J.

blocks.en: Contributions : (1) we introduce a floor, ceiling and headroom normalization for interpretability probes and identify two distinct mechanisms by which this headroom vanishes: weak target sensitivity and weak identification of the latent variable; (2) we show that under distribution shift raw decodability can reflect reduced headroom rather than a degraded representation; (3) we test this estimation procedure in different domains, showing how the choice of floor and ceiling distinguishes different scientific questions; (4) we show that the same raw probe score can imply different amounts of recovered headroom across settings.
blocks.zh: 贡献:(1) 我们为可解释性探测器引入了地平面、天花板和头室正常化,并找出了造成这个地平面消失的两种不同机制:目标灵敏度弱和潜在可变物识别能力弱;(2) 我们显示,在分配转移下,原始可解码性能够反映头室的缩小,而不是退化的代表性;(3) 我们测试不同领域的这一估计程序,显示对地平面和天花板的选择如何区分不同的科学问题;(4) 我们表明,同样的原始探测器得分可能意味着不同场合的回收地平面。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A probe trains a simple readout on hidden states and treats its predictive performance as evidence that a variable is represented ( Alain and Bengio, 2016 ; Belinkov, 2022 ) . Raw probe accuracy underdetermines this conclusion in three ways. Expressive probes can learn the task themselves ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ) . Random encoders already support high accuracy ( Zhang and Bowman, 2018 ; Wieting and Kiela, 2019 ) . Decodable information need not be used by the model ( Ravichander et al., 2021 ; Elazar et al., 2021 ; Kumar et al., 2022 ) . Proposed remedies either control probe capacity ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ; Voita and Titov, 2020 ) or estimate information content ( Pimentel et al., 2020 ) . Pimentel et al. (2020) note that, by the data-processing inequality, no representation carries more information about a target than its input does.
blocks.zh: 一个探测器对隐藏状态进行简单的读取,并将它的预测性能视为一个变量被代表的证据(Alain and Bengio, 2016; Belinkov, 2022.). 原始探测器精度从三个方面决定了这个结论。 表现式探测器可以自己学习任务(Hewitt and Liang, 2019.). 随机编码器已经支持高精度(张和鲍曼,2018;Wieting and Kiela,2019.). 该模型无需使用可解码的信息(Ravichander等,2021;Elazar等,2021;Kumar等,2022)。 拟议补救措施要么是控制探测能力(Hewitt和Liang, 2019;Voita和Titov, 2020),要么是估计信息内容(Pimentel等, 2020)。 Pimentel等人(2020年)指出,由于数据处理的不平等,没有代表所携带的关于目标的信息比其投入多。

blocks.en: Probing and related readouts are increasingly being used to make scientific claims about learned models, for example, that protein language models encode structure ( Rives et al., 2021 ) and that single-cell foundation models encode regulatory or cell-state information ( Cui et al., 2024 ; Theodoris et al., 2023 ) . Several audits find that such models often fail to beat simple baselines ( Kedzierska et al., 2025 ; Boiarsky et al., 2024 ; Ahlmann-Eltze et al., 2025 ) . A recent audit of scGPT and Geneformer finds that the apparent biological structure in attention adds nothing beyond trivial gene-level statistics ( Kendiukhov, 2026 ) . These studies choose baselines case by case and report raw differences. We formalize the question they share: how much a representation recovers beyond a declared simple baseline, relative to what is predictable from the available inputs, and apply it to scGPT, a fine-tuned TabPFN ( Hollmann et al., 2025 ; Grinsztajn et al., 2026 ) , and neural population activity. The latter two appear in Appendix J .
blocks.zh: 探索和相关读取正被越来越多地用于对所学模型提出科学诉求,例如:蛋白质语言模型编码结构(Rives等,2021年)和单细胞基模型编码调控或细胞状态信息(Cui等,2024年;Theodoris等,2023年). 一些审计发现,这些模型往往不能超越简单的基线(Kedzierska等,2025;Boiarsky等,2024;Ahlmann-Eltze等,2025)。 最近对ScGPT和Geneformer的审计发现,所关注的明显生物结构除了微不足道的基因水平统计之外,没有任何增加(Kendiukhof, 2026年)。 这些研究逐个选择基线,并报告原始差异。 我们正式确定他们共同的问题:相对于现有投入的可预期性,一个代表性恢复到多少超过一个已宣布的简单基线,并将其应用于一个经过微调的TabPFN(Holmann等人,2025年;Grinztajn等人,2026年)和神经人口活动。 后两项载于附录J。

blocks.en: Interpretations that are faithful in distribution can fail under systematic shift ( Friedman et al., 2023 ) . Causal methods such as nullspace projection and interchange interventions test whether decodable information is used ( Ravfogel et al., 2020 ; Geiger et al., 2024 ) . Our framework is complementary. It does not test causal use; it specifies, before any intervention, how much evidential weight a correlational score can carry in a given regime. It also shows that a drop in raw decodability under distribution shift can reflect reduced headroom rather than a degraded representation.
blocks.zh: 忠实于分布的解读在系统转变下可能失败(Friedman等,2023.). 诸如无空间投影和交换干预等致病方法测试是否使用可解码信息(Ravfogel等,2020年;Geiger等,2024年)。 我们的框架是相辅相成的。 它不检验因果关系的使用;它规定,在进行任何干预之前,一个相关分数在特定制度中可携带多少证据权重。 它还表明,在分配转变下原始可解码性下降,可能反映头室减少,而不是代表退化。

blocks.en: Meta-trained sequence models approximate Bayes-optimal inference ( Mikulik et al., 2020 ; Müller et al., 2021 ) , and transformers learn statistical estimators in context ( Garg et al., 2022 ; Akyürek et al., 2022 ; Bai et al., 2023 ) . Probes have been used to compare their internal quantities with classical estimators ( Teh et al., 2025 ) . We build on this line with random-effects meta-analysis ( Higgins and Thompson, 2002 ) .
blocks.zh: 元所训练的序列模型近似于Bayes-opestal推论(Mikulik等,2020年;Müller等,2021年),变压器在上下文中学习统计估计器(Garg等,2022年;Akyürek等,2022年;Bai等,2023年). 探测器被用来比较其内部数量与古典估计器(Teh等人,2025年)。 我们以随机效应元分析为基础(希金斯和汤普森,2002年)。

blocks.en: Single-cell RNA sequencing has the same structure as meta-analysis. Each example is a gene g g measured in K K cells. The normalized count of a cell varies for two reasons: technical noise, which decreases as the depth of the cell’s sequencing d g ​ i d_{gi} increases, and the biological variation from cell-to-cell, summarized by the overdispersion of the gene b g b_{g} . Under a Gamma–Poisson model the normalized count has variance λ g ​ ( d g ​ i − 1 + b g ) \lambda_{g}(d_{gi}^{-1}+b_{g}) , where λ g \lambda_{g} is the gene’s mean expression. Technical noise d g ​ i − 1 d_{gi}^{-1} therefore plays the role of the sampling variance σ i 2 \sigma_{i}^{2} , and overdispersion b g b_{g} the role of heterogeneity τ 2 \tau^{2} . The target is the analogue of log ⁡ S 1 \log S_{1} , the gene’s effective precision T g = log ∑ i = 1 K ( d g ​ i − 1 + b g ) − 1 T_{g}=\log\sum_{i=1}^{K}(d_{gi}^{-1}+b_{g})^{-1} , which depends on the hidden overdispersion. The restricted information is the sequencing depths alone, O g = d g , 1 : K O_{g}=d_{g,1:K} , and the full information adds the observed counts, I g = ( y g , 1 : K , d g , 1 : K ) I_{g}=(y_{g,1:K},d_{g,1:K}) , from which overdispersion can be inferred. We ask whether frozen scGPT ( Cui et al., 2024 ) encodes T g T_{g} beyond what depth alone predicts.

In the 10k human dataset, depth alone already reaches R 2 = 0.60 R^{2}=0.60 , so scGPT’s raw score of 0.81 0.81 recovers 57 % 57\% of the headroom. In the 20k donors dataset the raw score is much lower ( 0.57 0.57 ), but the floor is only 0.13 0.13 , so scGPT recovers a similar 52 % 52\% . Across the four datasets, raw scores range from 0.35 0.35 to 0.81 0.81 , while the fraction of headroom recovered ranges from 0.28 0.28 to 0.57 0.57 ; on synthetic genes it is 0.70 0.70 . scGPT therefore encodes biological overdispersion beyond sequencing depth, but only partially. scGPT probes use a 64-component PCA fitted on training rows only; all floors, ceilings and other probes use the full feature vectors (Appendix I ).

A floor computed from a description of the place name, its character 2–4-gram counts, reaches R 2 = 0.61 R^{2}=0.61 for world places and 0.46 for US places, yet the published probes recover 63–77% of the headroom above it. blocks.en: Truth. Marks and Tegmark (2023) report that LLMs represent whether a statement is true along a linear direction, and that a probe trained on one dataset of statements still works on another. We compute the floor from a description of each statement, its character and word n n -grams. Within a single dataset, this floor is near chance for most datasets but reaches 0.97–0.99 on larger_than and smaller_than datasets, whose truth labels follow from the wording of the numbers. Probes trained and tested on those two datasets therefore show little beyond the text. Transfer between datasets is more informative, because wording learned on one dataset does not carry over to another. A floor trained on the two number datasets and tested on Spanish–English translations is at chance (0.49), while the published probes reach 0.97 ( U H = 0.94 U_{H}=0.94 ). Trained on cities and neg_cities and tested on negated translations, the floor is again at chance (0.50), while the probes reach 0.96–0.99 ( U H U_{H} up to 0.98).

blocks.en: Summary. Probe normalization puts these published scores in perspective (Figure 5 ). Probe scores reach well above the floor when the target is not revealed by the surface form: coordinates at world scale, the effect of flips on the board, and truth transferred across datasets. When the target is written or cued in the input, such as borough names and numbers for New York City places, disc placement for the absolute board encoding, or attributes the role-played user writes into the conversation, the floor alone accounts for much of the score.
blocks.zh: 总结. 探险正常化使这些已公布的分数有目共睹(图5). 探测分数在目标未被地表形态所揭示时会达到地上远超地上:世界尺度的坐标,翻转板上的效果,以及跨数据集传输的真理. 当输入中写入或提示目标时,如为纽约市所处地标的区名和数字,绝对板编码的盘子放置,或将角色扮演用户写入对话中属性,仅地板就占了分数的大部分.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: A probe score of 0.6 0.6 has no fixed meaning. What it says about a representation depends on two quantities: how much of that predictability a declared baseline already provides, and how much the available data support in total. We made both explicit. The floor ρ O 2 \rho^{2}_{O} is what a declared baseline O O already predicts, the ceiling ρ I 2 \rho^{2}_{I} is what the full input I I supports, and the headroom Δ = ρ I 2 − ρ O 2 \Delta=\rho^{2}_{I}-\rho^{2}_{O} between them is the range in which a probe score can show information beyond O O . Headroom vanishes in two ways: weak target sensitivity, when the target stops depending on the latent variable, and weak identification, when the evidence stops revealing it.

Raw decodability of log ⁡ S 1 \log S_{1} and τ 2 \tau^{2} falls and prediction error rises, which alone suggests a degraded representation. The reference points show instead that the data lost information: the ceiling falls from 0.82 0.82 to 0.47 0.47 for log ⁡ S 1 \log S_{1} and from 0.76 0.76 to 0.40 0.40 for τ 2 \tau^{2} , while the floor for log ⁡ S 1 \log S_{1} rises only from 0.01 0.01 to 0.09 0.09 , so weak identification dominates. The representation recovers a similar share of the smaller headroom ( U H = 0.78 → 0.82 U_{H}=0.78\to 0.82 for log ⁡ S 1 \log S_{1} ; 0.84 → 0.85 0.84\to 0.85 for τ 2 \tau^{2} ).

blocks.en: The estimation recovers the exact reference points in two fully specified generative models and extends to settings where only samples are available. In frozen scGPT, similar raw scores correspond to different fractions of recovered headroom across datasets ( 0.28 0.28 – 0.57 0.57 ), so biological overdispersion is encoded only partially. For published LLM probes, a floor computed from the input text alone separates claims the text cannot explain (world-scale coordinates, the effect of flips in the relative Othello encoding, truth transferred across datasets) from claims it largely explains (New York City locations, the absolute Othello board, user attributes in role-played conversations).
blocks.zh: 该估计恢复了两个完全指定的基因模型中的确切参考点,并延伸到只有样本的设置. 在被冻结的scGPT中,相类似的生分数对应了跨数据集回收的头室的不同分数(0.28 0.28 – 0.57 0.57),因此生物过度分散只被部分编码. 对于已公布的LLM探测器,仅从输入文本中计算出的一楼,就声称文本无法解释(World-scale坐标,相对的Othello编码中翻转的效果,跨数据集传输的真相)与它主要解释的主张(纽约市位置,绝对的Othello板,角色扮演的对话中的用户属性).

blocks.en: The framework complements causal interventions: it bounds how much a correlational score can show before any intervention is run. We recommend that interpretability studies report the floor, the ceiling and the fraction of headroom recovered alongside raw scores, state the contrast ( O , I , T ) (O,I,T) before looking at probe scores, and, where no unique baseline exists, report a nested sequence O 1 ⊂ ⋯ ⊂ O k O_{1}\subset\dots\subset O_{k} so that readers can see how the choice of baseline affects the conclusions.
blocks.zh: 该框架是对因果干预的补充:它限定了在进行任何干预之前,相关得分可以显示多少。 我们建议,可解释性研究应报告在原始分数的同时回收的地平线、天花板和分数,在查看探测分数之前说明对比(O、I、T)(O、I、T),如果不存在独特的基线,则报告一个嵌入序列O 1========== O_{1}\ subset\ dots\ subset 这样读者就可以看到基线的选择如何影响结论.

blocks.en: Normalized scores are defined relative to a stated contrast ( O , I , T ) (O,I,T) . Different contrasts answer different scientific questions, so we report nested baselines (Appendix J ) rather than a single choice. On observational data the reference points are estimated, and an underestimated ceiling or floor inflates U H U_{H} . For published LLM probes the ceiling cannot be estimated and is set to 1 1 , so U H U_{H} there is approximate. Our controlled tasks are kept simple so that the reference points can be computed exactly, and the transformers trained on them are small.

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools to aid and polish writing, for retrieval and discovery of related work, for research execution, and to draft sections of the paper. As part of research execution, we used coding agents to assist with implementing and debugging analysis code and with producing scientific figures. We did not use generative AI tools for generating synthetic datasets or for proving mathematical claims. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work. AI-assisted code and analyses were inspected and their outputs were checked against the corresponding experiments and results; AI-assisted text and figures were reviewed for consistency with the underlying methods, analyses, and findings. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, code, figures, and other artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们使用基因AI工具来帮助并打磨作文,用于相关作品的检索和发现,研究执行,并起草论文的章节. 作为研究执行的一部分,我们使用编码剂协助执行并调试分析代码并生成科学数字. 我们没有使用基因AI工具来生成合成数据集或证明数学主张. 我们审查了所有AI协助的工作。 检查了AI协助的代码和分析,对照相应的实验和结果检查其产出;审查了AI协助的文本和数字,以便与基本方法、分析和调查结果保持一致。 我们负责这项工作的最后内容,包括文本、权利主张、代码、数字,以及在大赦国际的协助下制作的其他文物。

blocks.en: To test whether the estimation procedure generalizes beyond the controlled meta-analysis setting, we construct a second completely defined generative model based on single-cell RNA sequencing. blocks.en: Figure 7: The estimation procedure recovers exact reference points. Each marker compares an estimated reference point (decoder bank; vertical axis) with its exact value (horizontal axis), for the meta-analysis (circles) and the synthetic single-cell model (diamonds). Points lie close to the identity line (dotted) across regimes and reference-point types. Slightly negative estimated floors are held-out R 2 R^{2} values where the exact floor is near zero, not negative population floors.

We test the floor–ceiling construction in two independently specified
generative models: the random-effects meta-analysis model and a synthetic
single-cell RNA-sequencing model. In both cases the latent distribution and
observation model are known, so the reference points can be computed exactly, independently of the estimation procedure.

We independently estimate the same reference points from observed samples without
giving the estimator access to the true latent variable. Each seed is divided
into disjoint training, model-selection, and evaluation partitions. Candidate
regressors from the decoder bank are fitted on the training partition, the regressor class is fixed
using the selection partition, and the selected class is refitted on the
combined training and selection data before evaluation.

blocks.en: The quantities used for normalization in Section 4.1 are conditional on the choice of ( O , I , T ) (O,I,T) . In the controlled meta-analysis and synthetic single-cell experiments, the generative model identifies a natural distinction between restricted and full information. In the observational chemistry and neuroscience applications, however, there is no unique decomposition of the measurements into O O and I I , because changing the choice of ( O , I , T ) (O,I,T) changes the scientific estimand itself.
blocks.zh: 第4.1节中用于正常化的数量取决于(O、I、T)的选择。 在被控制的元分析和合成单细胞实验中,基因模型确定了限制信息与完整信息之间的自然区别. 然而,在观测化学和神经科学应用中,测量结果并没有独特的分解为O和I,因为改变(O,I,T)的选择(O,I,T)会改变科学刺激本身.

blocks.en: Neuroscience has long used decoding to ask what neural populations represent ( Quian Quiroga and Panzeri, 2009 ; Naselaris et al., 2011 ; Glaser et al., 2020 ) , and has documented its limits ( Kriegeskorte and Douglas, 2019 ; Ritchie et al., 2019 ; Hebart and Baker, 2018 ) . Two common practices resemble our reference points. First, decoding analyses control for confounds by removing the variance explained by variables that are not of interest ( Snoek et al., 2019 ) , and encoding studies split variance between feature sets ( de Heer et al., 2017 ) . Our floor plays this role, with the baseline stated explicitly and chosen by the scientific question. Second, encoding models are compared against a noise ceiling: the part of the neural response that repeats across identical trials, which no model can exceed ( Hsu et al., 2004 ; Schoppe et al., 2016 ; Lage-Castellanos et al., 2019 ) . Unlike a noise ceiling, which is limited by trial-to-trial variability in the response, the ceiling we define is limited by how much the available information reveals about the target.
blocks.zh: 神经科学长期使用解码来询问神经种群代表什么(Quian Quiroga and Panzeri,2009;Naselaris等,2011;Glaser等,2020),并记录了它的极限(Kriegeskorte和Douglas,2019;Ritchie等,2019;Hebart和Baker,2018). 两个共同的做法与我们的参照点相似。 首先,通过去除不感兴趣的变量(Snoek等,2019年)所解释的差异来解码分析控制错位(de Heer等,2017年),编码研究在特征集间分出差异(de Heer等,2017年). 我们的会场发挥这一作用,科学问题明确和选择了基线。 第二,编码模型被比作噪声天花板:神经反应中跨相同试验重复的部分,没有模型可以超过(Hsu等,2004;Schoppe等,2016;Lage-Castellanos等,2019.). 噪声上限受到反应中审判到审判的变异性的限制,与此不同,我们所定义的上限受到现有信息披露目标多少的限制.

blocks.en: Appendix L Conditional probing and predictive 𝒱 \mathcal{V} -information
blocks.zh: 附录 L 条件测试和预测 V\ mathcal{V} - 信息

blocks.en:
Hewitt et al. (2021) ,
based on predictive 𝒱 \mathcal{V} -information ( Xu et al., 2020 ) , ask how much information about a linguistic property, such as part of speech,
a contextual layer of a language model (ELMo, RoBERTa) contains beyond what
the non-contextual word embeddings already provide. The baseline B B is
therefore the embedding layer, and the quantity of interest is the
information that a deeper layer H H adds to it, I 𝒱 ​ ( H → Y ∣ B ) = H 𝒱 ​ ( Y ∣ B ) − H 𝒱 ​ ( Y ∣ B , H ) , I_{\mathcal{V}}(H\to Y\mid B)=H_{\mathcal{V}}(Y\mid B)-H_{\mathcal{V}}(Y\mid B,H), estimated by training one probe on B B and one on the concatenation [ B ; H ] [B;H] .
They contrast this with the earlier practice of comparing a probe on H H with
a probe on B B separately. That standalone comparison penalizes H H for any
information about word identity it has discarded, even when it adds new
contextual information. Under conditional probing, deeper layers turn out to
carry more information beyond the embeddings than standalone comparisons had
suggested.

We fit one linear probe per square on the residual stream
(block 5 for black/white/empty, block 6 for mine/theirs/empty; 1,000 games split
60/20/20), with O O the move-sequence features of rung O 3 O_{3} (disc placement without
flips) and a ceiling of 1, since the board is a function of the moves. Because
every probe here, including the floor, is linear, the floor (0.76 and 0.80) is slightly
lower than the decoder-bank floor of Appendix K . The standalone and
conditional scores reach the same verdict (Table 11 ). For
black/white/empty, H H adds nothing beyond disc placement: the conditional gain is − 0.001 -0.001 , U H = − 0.07 U_{H}=-0.07 and U H | O = 0.02 U_{H|O}=0.02 . For mine/theirs/empty, H H captures most of
what the flips add: the conditional gain is 0.18 0.18 , U H = 0.93 U_{H}=0.93 and U H | O = 0.94 U_{H|O}=0.94 .
The normalized and conditional normalized scores agree in both cases. Therefore, both methods support the conclusion of
Section 4.2.3 : a linear readout of the absolute board is explained by
disc placement, while with mine/theirs labels a linear probe recovers the board state that requires simulating flips.
